Since \(f(x)=f(2-x)\) and \(f(a_6)=f(a_{20})\), monotonicity on \((1,+\infty)\) gives
\[
a_6+a_{20}=2.
\]
For an arithmetic sequence,
\[
a_6+a_{20}=(a_1+5d)+(a_1+19d)=2a_1+24d=2,
\]
so
\[
a_1+12d=1.
\]
Thus \(a_{13}=1\). The sum of the first 25 terms is
\[
S_{25}=25a_{13}=25.
\]
\[
\boxed{25}
\]
